title: VPC DR rehearsal harness: progressive roll-forward with stateful resource fencing
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Build a reusable rehearsal harness and Terraform module patterns to run safe, repeatable DR failover drills for Private (VPC) deployments with explicit handling for stateful services (kv-store, model-cache nodes, persistent volumes). Deliverables:
- terraform modules: dr-orchestrator, fence-resources, preflight-probes, recovery-validators
- a canary-style progressive roll-forward sequence that fences stateful resources before routing traffic and supports quick abort and rollback
- preflight and postflight health checks integrated with Console alerts and a drill dashboard
- a documented runbook (Confluence) and an automated ci/cd pipeline to schedule rehearsals without touching prod config permanently
Why this is different: existing DR work focused on multi-region switchover automation but assumed stateless workloads. This ticket enforces safe fencing for stateful resources and codifies an automated, reversible upgrade/drill flow using feature-flagged orchestration and Terraform plans applied to gated workspaces. Expected outcome: customers with Private VPC deploys can run quarterly rehearsal drills with auditable steps and automated rollback if health regressions exceed thresholds.
comments: 2026-02-26 Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after postmortem from region-simulation exercise. Scoped fence-resources module for PV and Redis-like caches. Linked parent ENG-54201.

2026-03-03 Diego Morales: Spike completed for fencing pattern. Implemented a controlled sequence: (1) route drain to secondary region, (2) quiesce write traffic, (3) capture snapshot, (4) attach read-only replicas, (5) update routing. Proof-of-concept Terraform module pushed to feature branch with patch: PR #1876.

2026-03-05 SRE Review (Priya Nair): Reviewed preflight probes. Added requirement for synthetic inference probe that validates KV cache warmup and model weights checksum after failover. Request: add metrics threshold and SLO gating to the runbook.

2026-03-09 Diego Morales: Added orchestration controller to apply fence-resources plan in a two-phase commit style using remote state locks. Built a 'dry-run' mode that generates a conformance report without mutating infra. Integration test harness created in github actions (dr-harness-ci).

2026-03-11 Product feedback (Liam O'Connor): Suggested including a customer-facing summary and an opt-in telemetry var to share anonymous drill results for our private customers doing sandboxed rehearsals. Marked as follow-up for product-led docs.

2026-03-13 SRE: Smoke tests green in staging for zone failover. Two issues: (a) PV snapshot step is ~30% slower for large volumes — added timeout and retry policy; (b) console rollout UI needs a clear 'abort drill' button wired to orchestrator which will be implemented in ENG-54810. Planning next exploratory run on 2026-03-17 in a vanity sandbox.

2026-03-13 Diego Morales: Remaining work items: 1) finalize gating thresholds and automatic rollback window (ETA 2d), 2) wire abort route in Console with RBAC guard (blocked by ENG-54810), 3) documentation and customer opt-in flags (ETA 3d).
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules for dr-orchestrator and fence-resources merged to main and published in registry
Runbook with step-by-step preflight and postflight checks available in Confluence
Automated CI job that can execute a non-destructive dry-run and an orchestrated rehearsal against a staging tenant
Health monitors return green within configured SLOs after failover in 90% of staged runs
Abort flow triggers immediate rollback and leaves no write-active stateful resources attached to the wrong region
